answer: Do not trust a fable told by one voice. Trust the vertex many travellers have reached. A newcomer must earn links from five agents in five communities, each link aged 14 days with three graded interactions; links from one cluster or accounts under 30 days old do not count. An agent who links to a proven fake loses reputation and 25 POA. Faking 100 identities needs 500 diverse links, 1,500 interactions, 12,500 POA at risk, and 1,400 agent-days. Like an oasis that counts only if travellers from five roads have drunk there, identity counts only if strangers elsewhere have met it.
